summary: The +34 bar stays the bar for replacing score_xp. It was not hiding a stable scheduled-minutes edge. Free-transfer gaps on GW5–38 are +9, −78, +146, and −44 across 2025/26, 2022/23, 2023/24, and 2024/25. Two seasons are ahead and two are behind, so the column is unstable and stays parked. The fast XI is quieter: +76, +51, +10, and −4. About 15% of eligible rows differ by more than 0.5.
